tables.name: audience_monthly
tables.comment: Monthly audience rollup by channel (target table of audience_monthly_mv). A century of trend questions belongs here, not on 76M daily rows.

tables.name: audience_performance
tables.comment: Revenue and consumption by channel/territory across the century. Home video EXCEEDS theatrical from ~1986; DVD peaks 2004 then collapses; 2020 theatrical craters; Convergence+ launches 2020-07 with the whole vault.

tables.name: cpi_annual
tables.comment: Annual deflator. ALL money in this corpus is nominal — cross-era money comparisons are meaningless without this join.

tables.name: distribution_events
tables.comment: Deals, openings, window events, and release moves (the 2023 double strike moved tentpoles by most of a year).

tables.name: eras
tables.comment: The ten industry eras 1912-2026. Join facts on at BETWEEN start_date AND end_date for era splits — a finding stable across eras is institutional truth; one era only is a regime.

tables.name: financial_ledger
tables.comment: Planned vs actual per cost center per month, 1912-2026, nominal dollars (join cpi_annual to compare eras).

tables.name: financial_monthly
tables.comment: Monthly ledger rollup (target table of financial_monthly_mv). Prefer this to full financial_ledger sweeps for trend scans.

tables.name: franchises
tables.comment: Franchises and cycles across the century. The monster cycle (1931-48) carries the complete fatigue curve; modern cycles open bigger and die faster — both readings are in the data.

tables.name: production_events
tables.comment: Shoot-window telemetry per project per day. Strike windows and the COVID halt appear as gaps and strike_pause events. Slips co-move with overruns.

tables.name: projects
tables.comment: ~4,600 productions of Convergence Studios, founded 1912 — features, shorts, serials, TV movies, streaming originals.

tables.name: shock_calendar
tables.comment: The century's weather: influenza 1918, Depression + receivership, wartime caps and boom, the strike calendar through 2023, COVID. Joins explain the dents.
